        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (they share a household): it bypasses
            the household-duplicate block and declares the owner a household member, so
            it is also not flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is always
            derived from the last name and postcode regardless of this flag. A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Deterministic: the first 12
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last
                name and postcode computes the same value automatically. Null when
                the owner has no postcode (and so belongs to no household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level: a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present,
                gains a further 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount
                is 0), and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION component of the owner's region-and-hash identity: the
                customerCode prefix, i.e. the region derived from the postcode
                (2000-2099->NSW, 3000-3099->VIC, 4000-4099->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A composite derived value formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' +
                (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty), where householdId is
                derived from the last name and postcode. Duplicate detection itself is
                keyed on the household: a new owner is rejected with 409 when it shares
                an existing owner's household (same last name and postcode) unless it
                sets sharesHousehold. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same effective business day;
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode while
                having a different telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation
                time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (same last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                null when it is not a possible duplicate. Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:

              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-

                household (same last name and postcode). Deterministic: the first 12
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last
                name and postcode computes the same value automatically. Null when
                the owner has no postcode (and so belongs to no household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-

                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.

              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true

                creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present,

                is 0), and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).

              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:

              description: >-

                customerCode prefix, i.e. the region derived from the postcode

    Specialty:

      type: object

        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32

          example: 1

          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits.
            The result must have 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid email address; the stored value is lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Serialized as an ISO date
            'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present it is used
            to derive the owner's ageBand, computed against the registrationDate.
            Serialized as an ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be
            valid for the city's region: NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099. A city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. When supplied it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (they share a household): it bypasses
            the household-duplicate block and declares the owner a household member, so
            it is also not flagged as a possible duplicate. The householdId is always
            derived from the last name and postcode regardless of this flag. A
            request-only flag; it is not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode (NSW/VIC/QLD, or UNKNOWN
                when the postcode is absent or in no known range) and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the last name. Assigned at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode. Derived from the owner's own
                fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners who belong to the same
                household (same last name and postcode). Deterministic: the first 12
                upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name,
                a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last
                name and postcode computes the same value automatically. Null when
                the owner has no postcode (and so belongs to no household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name
                (case-insensitively). Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-A1B2C3D4-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level: a number from 1 to 3 assigned at
                creation. Starts at 1, gains 1 when an email address is present,
                gains a further 1 when the owner has no namesakes (namesakeCount
                is 0), and is capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
                Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The REGION component of the owner's region-and-hash identity: the
                customerCode prefix, i.e. the region derived from the postcode
                (2000-2099->NSW, 3000-3099->VIC, 4000-4099->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode is absent or in no known range. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band derived from birthDate computed against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' when 65 or over. Null when birthDate is absent.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A composite derived value formed as normalizedTelephone + '|' +
                (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty), where householdId is
                derived from the last name and postcode. Duplicate detection itself is
                keyed on the household: a new owner is rejected with 409 when it shares
                an existing owner's household (same last name and postcode) unless it
                sets sharesHousehold. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners
                had already been created on the same effective business day;
                otherwise false. Assigned at creation time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode while
                having a different telephone; otherwise false. Assigned at creation
                time.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (same last name and postcode, different telephone), or
                null when it is not a possible duplicate. Assigned at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

The task was to expose a human-readable `telephoneDisplay` field on the owner API while keeping the raw `telephone` in E.164 form. The project generates `OwnerDto` from `openapi.yml` and maps it from the `Owner` entity's transient getters via MapStruct, so I made two matching changes:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `telephoneDisplay` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field and MapStruct auto-maps it by name (the same pattern as `displayName`, `initials`, `locality`, etc.).

2. **`src/main/java/.../model/Owner.java`** — added a `@Transient getTelephoneDisplay()` deriving the display string from the stored E.164 value: it splits off the country code (`+1` NANP = 1 digit, otherwise 2 digits, matching the recognized `+61`/`+1` forms this app normalizes to), then re-joins as `country code` + space + national digits grouped in threes. It returns the raw value unchanged when the telephone is absent or not a `+`-prefixed digit run (so non-normalized seed data doesn't break).

For the test's stored `+61412345678` this yields `+61 412 345 678`, while `$.telephone` stays `+61412345678`.

- Target test `AcceptanceTest.coreFormatsTelephoneDisplay`: **passes**.
- Full `mvn test`: **BUILD SUCCESS**, 1 test, 0 failures/errors (the only concrete test class; `AcceptanceBase` is abstract and `AuditLogCapture` is a helper).
